name: Seachem Flourish Trace
description: Concentrated trace-element supplement (boron, cobalt, manganese, molybdenum, zinc, etc.). Seachem does not publish a per-dose ppm, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Label dose ~5 ml per 80 L twice weekly. Replenishes trace minerals depleted by uptake + water changes; complements Flourish Comprehensive.
